about_the_game:
The Blastermancer is a powerful robot with unimaginable laser blasting ability, tasked with defending the astro realm from vicious space monsters.

Waves of the space monsters will attack you each level, you must dodge and jump around them and destroy them all with your blaster-arm!

When you begin the game, it will feel like classic arcade action, but soon the enemies will become too strong... but over time the simple upgrade system will allow you to start with insane upgrades and lay waste to your foes!

every lazer that hits an enemy will cause frame drops and slowdown, like in a classic beat-em-up (this is intentional but can be easily turned off!)  use this to your advantage to slow down the baddies

 

the game has roguelike elements but also a simple upgrade system that will power up the player beyond recognition.

you will blast your way thru 30 stages of blaster mayhem and 7+ hours of gamepla

FEATURES:

  • single player retro arcade experience with frantic shoot-em-up gameplay

  • 30 stages of ever-increasing swarms of space monsters

  • Roguelike style item system makes each play through unique

  • Progression system makes player more powerful with every attempt

  • Intense neon graphics (screenshake and other graphical effects are adjustable)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 (2 GB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Blastermancer is a crunchy, lo-fi platform shooter where you control a robot whose sole purpose is to obliterate space demons. Beginning as a mix of 80s arcade and rogue-like, the game transforms into a cacophonous ballet of lasers and pixel dust.
